questionText: Suppose the values $10, -4, 15, 30, 20, 5, 60, 19$ are inserted in that order into an initially empty binary search tree. Let $T$ be the resulting binary search tree. The number of edges in the path from the node containing $19$ to the root node of $T$ is ________. (Answer in integer)
explanation:
Step-by-step Explanation:

1. Constructing the Binary Search Tree (BST):
• Insert 10: Root node = $10$
• Insert -4: $-4 < 10 \implies$ Left child of $10$
• Insert 15: $15 > 10 \implies$ Right child of $10$
• Insert 30: $30 > 10, 30 > 15 \implies$ Right child of $15$
• Insert 20: $20 > 10, 20 > 15, 20 < 30 \implies$ Left child of $30$
• Insert 5: $5 < 10, 5 > -4 \implies$ Right child of $-4$
• Insert 60: $60 > 10, 60 > 15, 60 > 30 \implies$ Right child of $30$
• Insert 19: $19 > 10, 19 > 15, 19 < 30, 19 < 20 \implies$ Left child of $20$

2. Path from Node 19 to the Root Node (10):
The path from the node $19$ to the root $10$ goes through:
$19 \rightarrow 20 \rightarrow 30 \rightarrow 15 \rightarrow 10$

3. Counting Edges:
• Edge 1: $(19, 20)$
• Edge 2: $(20, 30)$
• Edge 3: $(30, 15)$
• Edge 4: $(15, 10)$

Total number of edges = 4.
